scope: Contract and ownership gate for Hero-detail header/basic information.

identityNotRebuilt.rule: Stage 5-5 consumes the existing canonical 267-Hero identity master and does not reselect playable Heroes from ConfigData.

discardedHypothesisGuard.rule: HeroInfo Field 16 / ExchangedFragmentCount is explicitly forbidden as a rarity source.

candidateFieldSemanticGuard.rule: Readable field names are not promoted to authoritative page-display semantics without source/coverage validation.

nonSynthesisPolicy.rule: Missing enrichment values remain null/review until an accepted source is validated.

fields.rarity: No accepted authoritative page source yet; validate independently in 5-5-2.
fields.factions: No accepted canonical Hero-to-faction source yet; validate independently in 5-5-2.
fields.cv: No accepted authoritative page source yet; validate independently in 5-5-2.
fields.origin: HeroInfo.HeroBelongProduction is a field-name candidate only; validate semantics and coverage before adoption.
fields.artwork: HeroInfo.CharImage_ID is a candidate identifier; validate asset resolution and coverage before adoption.
fields.skins: HeroInfo.Skins_ID is a candidate membership source; validate skin identity, ordering and acquisition metadata before adoption.

completionRule: 5-5-1 is complete because the canonical identity source, header schema ownership, pending-enrichment set, anti-inference guards and downstream ownership boundaries are fixed. Pending enrichment extraction is expected work for 5-5-2 and does not reopen 5-5-1.
nextStage: 5-5-2: authoritative source and coverage validation for rarity, factions, CV, origin, artwork and skins.
